_comment: PHASE 1 (Goal 26). Which real recording serves which cue. Every id was found by tools/audio/freesound-fetch.mjs --search and its licence is re-verified on the sound's own page at download time, so this file is a shopping list and NOT the licence record — Assets/audio/manifest.json is. Several entries are deliberately compilation recordings ('various', 'open close'): one file yields several variants once sliced, which is how a cue stops sounding machine-stamped.
